nodes.title: Visualizer video · usage
widgets_values:
Creates a video from a still image with a bar or dots spectrum.
Turn **enabled** on to export a video with your generated song. Choose the image in **Visualizer still**.
_The video resolution will match the input image._ Adjust the visualizer options with a mock preview of your settings below. ## Reducing file size If you're looking for smaller files: 1. Use the h265/opus codecs (large difference vs h265/flac). 2. Lower the resolution by picking a smaller input image. 3. Use 30 fps (small difference). Requires FFmpeg, with `showcqt` and support for your selected codec.

nodes.title: Acoustic tips
widgets_values:
### Stronger style adherence - Set **Music guidance** above `1.0`, for example between 2-3.
(This will generate slower.) ### More detail and layered instruments Try **Music temperature** first. Fine tune with `top_p` (lower for more variance). - Increased temperature, for example `1.20`
More variance and layered instruments but deviates from ABC and style prompt more. - Decreased temperature, for example `0.80`
Stronger ABC and style adherence but can sound clinical and flat.

nodes.title: About and usage
widgets_values:
## YuE2 Kit - Song workflow _An intuitive workflow for YuE2 power users._ This workflow tries to give you access to all the cool things YuE2 can do, without getting complicated. ## Basic usage Turn lyrics and a style prompt into music, with an ABC score. 1. Set **Lyrics + style** and the **Seed**. 2. Choose a reference, or **None** for a fresh score. 3. Check **Model files**, then run. Preview the score in the center of the workflow.
**Final outputs** saves the song as FLAC and ABC files. ### Instrumental LoRA 1. Above the lyrics input set `instrumental: true`. 2. Follow the cheat sheet hints, for instrumental prompts. 3. Make sure you have the LoRA downloaded 👉 ### Reference input Supports input ABC and Transcribing from audio/video files.
See the "Reference input" section on the top left. ### Visualizer video An optional video can be created with a visualizer.
See "Visualizer video" on the right of the workflow. ## Using custom nodes Not every custom node is fully stable yet, but you can use them in your own workflows. It's best to use them from the registry: - [YuE2-Kit](https://registry.comfy.org/publishers/bno84/nodes/comfyui-yue2-kit) - [ABC Preview](https://registry.comfy.org/publishers/bno84/nodes/comfyui-abcpreview) - [Audio Visualizer](https://registry.comfy.org/publishers/bno84/nodes/comfyui-audiovisualizer)

nodes.title: Prompting cheat sheet
widgets_values:
# Normal YuE2

### Lyrics

```
[verse]
Footsteps in the morning rain
Take me down this road again

[chorus]
Let the daylight carry through
Every road leads back to you
```

### Style

Describe the genre, instruments, vocals, mood, and tempo.

```
warm piano pop, female vocals, acoustic piano,
rounded bass, light drums, hopeful, 88 BPM
```

_Note: using reference ABC/Transcription will force a different tempo._

Natural language can be mixed in.

```
jazz, 110 BPM, relaxed saxophone with gradual introduction of drums, acoustic piano, rounded bass and light drums, dynamic composition, experimental
```

---

# Instrumental LoRA

### Lyrics

```
[intro]
[verse]
[chorus]
[outro]
```

Supports timed tags, but **guidance only**. The LoRA tends toward _3–5 minute songs_ and section timing is not exact.

```
[intro 0:00-0:15]
[verse 0:15-0:45]
[chorus 0:45-1:10]
```

### Style

Stays the same as normal YuE2.
